intro: Goenka College of Commerce and The Bhawanipur Education Society College both sit in Kolkata, and this page compares their recorded BCom fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

Goenka College of Commerce vs The Bhawanipur Education Society College is not a single winner. Goenka College of Commerce is recorded as a public institute, while The Bhawanipur Education Society College is private. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: Goenka College of Commerce vs The Bhawanipur Education Society College for BCom: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Goenka College of Commerce if you want a public BCom option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose The Bhawanipur Education Society College if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.

Goenka College of Commerce lists Bachelor of Commerce (Hons). The Bhawanipur Education Society College lists Bachelor of Commerce (Hons) Accounting & Finance, Bachelor of Commerce (Hons) E-Commerce, Bachelor of Commerce (Hons) Marketing and more.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹1.9 lakh a year as total fees for Goenka College of Commerce's Bachelor of Commerce (Hons). Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹41,400 a year as total fees for The Bhawanipur Education Society College's Bachelor of Commerce (Hons) E-Commerce. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, Goenka College of Commerce's 2023 figures are an average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹6 lakh for Bachelor of Commerce (Hons). These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, The Bhawanipur Education Society College's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh for Bachelor of Commerce (Hons) Marketing. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for Goenka College of Commerce on this BCom page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for The Bhawanipur Education Society College on this BCom page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Kolkata, West Bengal. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, Goenka College of Commerce is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
The Bhawanipur Education Society College can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
